name: Yahoo Inbox Cleanup
notes:
Runs daily at 9am CT. Searches for promotional emails (has:unsubscribe) addressed to caresir@yahoo.com. Deletes promos older than 30 days, archives recent promos. Financial and important emails are skipped. Sends Kareesa a summary to cham4547@gmail.com.

SETUP:
1. Import this file into n8n (Workflows > Import)
2. Open the workflow and update the Gmail credential in every Gmail node to match your connected account
3. Run once manually to test before activating
4. Toggle Active ON to enable the daily schedule

TO GUARD REAL ESTATE GMAIL TRIGGER:
In your Real Estate lead intake Gmail trigger, add this to the search filter:
  -from:caresir@yahoo.com -to:caresir@yahoo.com
This prevents Yahoo subscription emails from being processed as leads.
